name: Halloween 2026
description: Thriller Bark has dropped anchor for the whole month. Four nights of quests, thirty-six trials, and a crew of Halloween 2026 cards to drag back from the fog.
final_message: Every shadow on this ship is yours now. Happy Halloween, and yohohoho!
notes: Placeholders to replace before launch: the two craft quests point at the Perona and Gecko Moria collectors until the Halloween crafts exist (The Doctor's Assistant, Nightmare Crafting). The Halloween 2026 special still has a rarity of 0: raise it or no catch-a-Halloween quest can be done. Position 1 leaves the Birthday Voyage (position 0) as the default pass while both run. Three quests are hidden (Thirteen Treats, A Skeleton's Shadow, Shadows Beyond Counting): players only see them once completed, and they never count towards finishing a tier.

tiers.name: The Fog Rolls In
tiers.description: A ship the size of an island slides out of the fog. Nobody remembers seeing it arrive. Six trials to prove you belong aboard.
tiers.completion_message: Thriller Bark is boarded, and Ryuma the zombie samurai rises on your side. ⚔️

quests.name: Trick or Treat
quests.description: Trick or treat! Give a treasure to someone on your friend list.

quests.name: Candy Bag
quests.description: Fill your bag: catch 15 treasures.

quests.name: First Fright
quests.description: Something moved in the rigging. Catch a Halloween 2026 treasure.

quests.name: Costume Shopping
quests.description: No costume, no candy. Buy 2 packs, any packs.

quests.name: Grave Goods
quests.description: Buy a Thriller Bark extras pack: the dead keep the good stuff.

quests.name: Sweet Tooth
quests.description: Claim your daily pack three days in a row.

quests.name: The Sleeping Giant
quests.description: Something enormous snores below deck. Catch Little Oars Jr.

quests.name: Séance
quests.description: Some doors only open in pairs. Complete 2 trades with friends.

quests.name: Weekly Offering
quests.description: The ship feeds every week. Catch 20 treasures, and again next week.

quests.name: Thirteen Treats
quests.description: Nobody asked you to. You knocked on thirteen doors anyway and gave a treasure at every one.
quests.completion_message: Thirteen treats given away. The ship noticed.

tiers.name: Hogback's Laboratory
tiers.description: Behind the mansion doors, a surgeon stitches corpses into soldiers. He needs parts, money and an assistant. You qualify.
tiers.completion_message: The laboratory falls quiet, and the doctor walks out with you. 🧟

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: The doctor is not picky. Catch 30 treasures.

quests.name: Fresh Specimens
quests.description: Only the freshest will do. Catch 3 Halloween 2026 treasures.

quests.name: Surgery Bill
quests.description: Hogback's surgeries don't come cheap. Spend 25,000 berries, anywhere.

quests.name: Black Market
quests.description: Buy 2 items from the merchant. No questions asked.

quests.name: Zombie Army
quests.description: Raise your own crew: have 6 Halloween 2026 treasures in your collection.

quests.name: Hunting Party
quests.description: Nobody hunts alone on this ship. Exchange 6 treasures in trades with friends.

quests.name: The Doctor's Assistant
quests.description: Assemble something of your own: craft the Perona collector card.
quests.notes: Placeholder: swap the collector for the Halloween craft once it exists, and decide whether it becomes mandatory.

quests.name: Ghost Stories
quests.description: Pay your friends for their silence: give 10,000 berries to friends.

quests.name: Midnight Snack
quests.description: Claim your daily berries five days in a row.

tiers.name: The Shadow Thief
tiers.description: Scissors snip in the dark and your shadow is gone. Take enough of them back and the thief will notice you.
tiers.completion_message: Your shadow is back where it belongs, and Moria noticed. 🌑

quests.name: Stolen Shadows
quests.description: Catch 6 Halloween 2026 treasures.

quests.name: Graveyard Shift
quests.description: Work the night through: catch 60 treasures.

quests.name: Shadow Collector
quests.description: Have 12 Halloween 2026 treasures in your collection.

quests.name: Buggy's Haunted Shop
quests.description: Buy 3 treasures from Buggy's shop before he notices the smell.

quests.name: Blood Pact
quests.description: Seal it with your crew: exchange 10 treasures in trades with friends.

quests.name: Bone Collector
quests.description: Be quicker than the hounds: catch 5 treasures less than 7 seconds after they appear.

quests.name: Negative Hollow
quests.description: A ghost princess floats through the wall. Catch Perona.

quests.name: Auction of the Damned
quests.description: Outbid the dead: win 2 auctions on the auction house.

quests.name: All Souls
quests.description: The thief counts what you keep: have 25 treasures of T60 or rarer in your collection.

quests.name: A Skeleton's Shadow
quests.description: Someone on this ship lost his shadow fifty years ago. You found him first.
quests.completion_message: Yohohoho! You found the skeleton before the Warlord did.

tiers.name: Nightmare on Thriller Bark
tiers.description: The Warlord stops laughing. Whatever walks the deck tonight was built to stop you, and dawn is still a week away.
tiers.completion_message: The haunted island is yours. Sail it home before dawn. 🏴‍☠️

quests.name: Master of Shadows
quests.description: Catch 10 Halloween 2026 treasures.

quests.name: Moria's Collection
quests.description: Match the Warlord: have 20 Halloween 2026 treasures in your collection.

quests.name: Warlord's Wealth
quests.description: Buy your way through the nightmare: spend 75,000 berries.

quests.name: Rare Hunt
quests.description: Only trophies count now: catch 3 treasures of T40 or rarer.

quests.name: Crew of the Damned
quests.description: Nobody leaves this ship alone: complete 10 trades with friends.

quests.name: Nightmare Crafting
quests.description: Build your own monster: craft the Gecko Moria collector card.
quests.notes: Placeholder: swap the collector for the second Halloween craft once it exists.

quests.name: The Ghost Ship
quests.description: The island itself drifts past once a year. Catch Thriller Bark.

quests.name: All Hallows' Eve
quests.description: Never miss a night: claim your daily berries fourteen days in a row.

quests.name: Last Call at Buggy's
quests.description: Sell the bones you don't need: earn 30,000 berries selling treasures to Buggy.

quests.name: Shadows Beyond Counting
quests.description: Thirty stolen shadows in one collection. Even Moria never managed that.
quests.completion_message: Thirty shadows. The Warlord is jealous.
